newsitem.title: SPAIN: Telefonica opens steady at 3,360 ptas after sale.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica opens steady at 3,360 ptas after sale.

text.p: Shares in Spain's Telefonica started bourse trade at 3,360 pesetas ($23.32) on Tuesday, unchanged from Monday's close after the privatisation of the government's last 20.9 percent stake in the firm ended.
Late Monday, state holding company SEPPa set the final share price for the retail tranche of its sale at 3,239 pesetas, and the institutional price at 3,360 pesetas.
The institutional tranche was four times oversubscribed.

Total demand for the Telefonica shares was 3.56 billion pesetas (1.057 million shares) -- 2.5 billion pesetas (768 million shares) in the retail tranche and 1.06 billion pesetas (319 million shares) in the institutional tranche.

Telefonica said it had increased the retail share offer to 114 million shares to ensure each investor received at least 100 shares. Those who subscribed for more received two percent of the amount requested over the minimum 100.
The share offer was Spain's largest flotation ever, worth 5.0 percent of total bourse capitalisation, Telefonica said.
